name: Plopsaland Ardennes (Plopsa Coo)
price: Dated tickets from €20 if 1 m or taller; €16 for 85–99 cm and for 70+; under 85 cm free. Family tickets €95/€120/€149/€169 for 3–6 people
notes: Includes chairlift and Coo waterfall setting. Smurfs Halloween 17 Oct–8 Nov 2026. Parking sold separately, amount not published.
summary: Pretpark in de Ardennen met attracties en stoeltjeslift bij de Coo-watervallen.

name: Château de Reinhardstein
notes: Guided visit. Tours in French and Dutch; English handouts, not an English tour.
summary: Middeleeuws kasteel uit 1354 met rondleidingen in het weekend.

name: High Fens: Signal de Botrange, Fagne de la Poleûr, Maison du Parc
distance: About 10 min (Signal de Botrange); Maison du Parc about 11 min
price: Walks free. Maison du Parc FANIA exhibition adults €8, children €4.50, seniors €7. Horse-cart ride Sat 17, Sun 18, Wed 21 Oct only: adults €13, children €8.65
hours: Open every day 15–23 Oct. Maison du Parc: Mon–Fri 9:00–17:00, weekends and holidays 10:00–17:00
notes: Walks, visitor centre, nature exhibition.
summary: Hoogste punt van België met wandelpaden door de Hoge Venen en bezoekerscentrum.

name: Les Canaillous
address: Malmedy Expo, Rue Devant les Religieuses 2A, 4960 Malmedy, Belgium
price: €5 first child, €4 each further child, afternoon
hours: 13:30–18:30. Closed Thu 15 and Fri 16; open Sat 17 and Sun 18; open daily Mon 19–Fri 23 during school holiday
notes: Covered play centre, Malmedy Expo. Ages 1–12.
summary: Overdekt binnenspeelcentrum voor kinderen van 1 tot 12 jaar.

name: Abbaye de Stavelot
notes: Includes the Spa-Francorchamps circuit museum.
summary: Abdijcomplex met historische musea inclusief Spa-Francorchamps racebaanmuseum.

name: Domaine de Bérinzenne and Musée de la Forêt et des Eaux
price: Woods free. Museum: under 3 free, ages 3–5 €2, 6+ €4, adults €7, 60+ €5
hours: Museum open Thu 15; closed Fri 16 and Sat 17; open Sun 18 through Thu 22; closed Fri 23
notes: Boardwalks are not for pushchairs.
summary: Natuurdomein met wandelpaden op vlonders door het veen en bosmuse um.

name: Grottes de Remouchamps
hours: Open every day of the stay; hours depend on season (on 3 Oct the page said 9:30–17:00)
notes: Guided cave walk with boat.
summary: Ondergrondse grotten met rondleiding en bootvaart op ondergrondse rivier.

name: Lac de Robertville
notes: Free lakeside walk. Beach, boats, and swimming are May–September only, so not this trip.
summary: Stuwmeer met wandelpad langs de oever en uitzicht op het kasteel.

name: Ferme Libert
notes: Short walk to see deer and wild boar, Bevercé.
summary: Kleinschalig wildpark met herten en wilde zwijnen in Bévercé.

name: Wesertalsperre / barrage de la Vesdre
hours: In October the centre can close on Mondays in bad weather, so Monday 19 is the weather-risk day
notes: Dam wall, forest trail, playground, Eupen.
summary: Stuwdam met wandelpad, bos en speeltuin in Eupen.

name: Monschau old town
notes: Free walk through the half-timbered lanes, Germany. Castle interior has no regular public hours.
summary: Historisch vakwerkstadje in Duitsland met smalle straatjes.

name: Railbike des Hautes Fagnes
hours: Public departures Saturday and Sunday only. For this stay: Sat 17 and Sun 18, at 11:00, 13:30, and 15:45
notes: Leykaul.
summary: Draisinetrocht op voormalige spoorlijn, alleen weekend vertrek.

name: Xhoffraix family walk (MDY04)
notes: Easy 3.4 km loop. Pin is the village parking lot beside Taverne Chez Remy, not the trail itself.
summary: Korte gezinswandeling van 3,4 km door het dorp Xhoffraix.

name: Parc des Tanneries playground
notes: Malmedy. Adults and children over 11 are not allowed to use the equipment. Pin is the car park (free, 2 hour max) on Rue de la Warchenne, about 130 m from the playground.
summary: Openbare speeltuin in het stadspark van Malmedy.

name: Malmedy Battle Tour
notes: Free self-guided walk of 22 photo panels in the town centre. Pin is the town visitor car park Malmundarium (P10), Rue Devant l'Etang, not a panel on the walk.
summary: Gratis zelfgeleide wandeling langs 22 fotopanelen over WOII in het centrum.

name: Malmedy Massacre Memorial, Baugnez
notes: Outdoor memorial only. The Baugnez 44 museum closed permanently on 9 January 2023 and is not visitable. Pin is the memorial; no public lot is mapped beside it.
summary: Herdenkingsmonument voor het Malmedy-bloedbad uit december 1944.

name: December 44 Museum, La Gleize
hours: 10:00–18:00, last entry 17:00. Likely Thursday–Monday plus every day during Belgian school holiday starting 19 Oct (which would cover 19–23 Oct). Check before a Tuesday or Wednesday visit before 19 Oct
notes: King Tiger outside. Pin is the museum car park.
summary: Museum met King Tiger tank over de Ardennenslag van december 1944.

name: Henri-Chapelle American Cemetery
address: 159 rue du Mémorial Américain, 4852 Hombourg, Belgium
hours: Daily 9:00–17:00 except 25 Dec and 1 Jan, last admission 16:45
notes: 159 rue du Mémorial Américain, 4852. Pin is the cemetery car park at the west gate, open 9:00–17:00.
summary: Amerikaanse militaire begraafplaats met 7992 graven uit WOII.

name: Bastogne War Museum
distance: About 68 min, 77 km, so it can run over an hour
price: Adults 19–64 €28, seniors €24.50, children 6–18 €15.50, under 6 free, family €72, parking €7.50
hours: Mid-October hours were not confirmed (a ticket page showed 9:30–18:00 only for 4–6 Oct)
notes: Mardasson memorial centre is closed because of falling concrete through about spring 2029; grounds and crypt still open. Pin is the museum car park (paid).
summary: Museum en gedenkplaats over de Slag om Bastenaken en Ardennenslag.

name: Stavelot memorials
notes: Place du 18 décembre and Cour de Commémoration. Outdoor, no ticket. Pin is the car park by the square, not the abbey.
summary: Buitenmonumenten ter nagedachtenis aan burgerslachtoffers in december 1944.

name: 1st Infantry Division memorial
notes: Roundabout west of Büllingen.
summary: Gedenkplaats voor Amerikaanse soldaten zonder geschikte toegangsweg.

name: Elsenborn Ridge memorial
notes: The stele, Wirtzfeld. Not the active military range. Pin is the memorial; no car park is mapped beside it.
summary: Gedenksteen voor het 2e en 99e Amerikaanse Infanterie Division bij Wirtzfeld.

name: Westwall-Weg, Simonskall
hours: Medical bunker interior open Sundays March–November only (Sunday 18 Oct in this window)
notes: 8 km walk past Siegfried Line bunkers. Do not enter other bunkers. Pin is the Simonskall trailhead car park.
summary: Wandeling van 8 km langs Siegfried-liniebunkers, medische bunker zondag open.

name: Musée de la Bataille des Ardennes, La Roche-en-Ardenne
hours: Closed Thu 15 and Fri 16 Oct; open Sat 17 through Fri 23
notes: Pin is the car park beside the museum (paid).
summary: Museum over de Slag in de Ardennen met voertuigen en uniformen.

name: Boulangerie Bayetto
address: Rue de la Borbotte 2, 4960 Bévercé (Malmedy), Belgium
hours: Monday closed; Tue, Wed, Fri 06:30–18:00; Thursday closed; Saturday 07:00–17:30; Sunday 07:00–14:30
notes: Artisan bakery; customers mention tarte au riz and gâteau de Verviers. Closed Thu 15 and Thu 22 Oct. Hours from uncoindeterroir.fr, checked 4 Oct 2026.
summary: Ambachtelijke bakkerij bekend om tarte au riz en gâteau de Verviers.

name: Boulangerie Gilon
notes: Opened 2002; bread, viennoiserie and pastry on site; tarte au riz, Vaution de Verviers, tarte à la maquée. Closed Tue 20 Oct. Hours from shop site, checked 4 Oct 2026.
summary: Bakkerij sinds 2002 met ter plaatse gebakken brood en gebak.

name: Boulangerie Pâtisserie Chez Dijan
notes: Hand-shaped bread, éclairs, fruit tarts, mille-feuilles, sandwiches; about 60 seats. Closed Sun 18 and Mon 19 Oct. Hours from maitre-boulanger-patissier.be, checked 4 Oct 2026.
summary: Bakkerij met handgevormde broden, eclairs en gebak, ongeveer 60 zitplaatsen.

name: Halmes (Malmedy délices et tradition)
notes: Family shop since 1970, known for sourdough, rye and a very dark wholemeal loaf. Closed Mon 19, Tue 20 and Wed 21 if operator site is correct. Hours from halmes.be (operator site), checked 4 Oct 2026. Older OSM and Petit Futé say Tuesday–Sunday; note the conflict.
summary: Familiebakkerij sinds 1970 bekend om zuurdesembroden en donker volkorenbrood.

name: L'Artisan des Gonesses
notes: Reopened 8 August 2026 as a citizen project around a large wood-fired oven; gonesses, pain d'Ardenne, gosettes. Hours from uncoindeterroir.fr directory, checked 4 Oct 2026.
summary: Burgerproject met grote houtoven voor brood en Ardense specialiteiten.

name: Boulangerie-Pâtisserie Heindrichs
hours: Closed Monday and Tuesday; weekdays (Wed–Fri) 06:00–18:30; Saturday 07:00–17:00; Sunday 07:00–17:00
notes: Since 1971; Walloon-flour bread, pastry, pralines, seasonal printen. Closed Mon 19 and Tue 20 Oct. Hours from shop site, checked 4 Oct 2026.
summary: Bakkerij sinds 1971 met Waals meel, gebak, pralines en seizoensgebak.

name: Marichal
notes: Wood-fired bread and small grocery with sandwiches. Hours from OpenStreetMap (last edited 2022), not the shop; unconfirmed.
summary: Bakkerij met houtoven en kleine kruidenierswinkel voor broodjes.

name: Boulangerie Pâtisserie Heinen
hours: Mon, Wed, Thu, Fri 07:00–13:30; Tuesday closed; Saturday 07:00–14:00; Sunday 07:00–12:00
notes: Family bakery. Closed Tue 20 Oct. Hours from Bottin, checked 4 Oct 2026; afternoon unconfirmed (old OSM tag showed later afternoons).
summary: Familiebakkerij met vers brood en gebak, gesloten op dinsdag.

name: P.H. Hennes (Boulangerie Philippe Hennes)
notes: Everyday bread and pastry. Hours from OpenStreetMap (edited 2018); stale. Tuesday and Wednesday not listed as open.
summary: Dorpsbakkerij met dagelijks brood en gebak.

name: Chez Dumoulin
hours: Monday, Tuesday and Sunday closed; Wednesday–Friday 07:00–14:00; Saturday 07:30–16:00
notes: Bakery with takeaway. Hours from Bottin, checked 4 Oct 2026 (shop site returned an error).
summary: Bakkerij met afhaalservice, gesloten op maandag, dinsdag en zondag.

name: Bäckerei Mertens-Miesen
notes: Bakery; site under construction. Closed Wed 21 Oct. Hours from shop site and OSM (checked June 2026) agree.
summary: Bakkerij in Büllingen, gesloten op woensdag.

name: La Gourmandine
address: Rue de la Poterie 10, 4950 Faymonville, Belgium
notes: Village bakery; bread and sandwiches mentioned in comments.
summary: Dorpsbakkerij met brood en broodjes.

name: Xhoffraix en famille (MDY04)
parkingAddress: Ruelle Adam 1-9, 4960 Xhoffraix (Chez Remy tavern parking)
notes: Easy family walk through Xhoffraix village. Start at Chez Remy tavern parking.
summary: Zeer gemakkelijke gezinswandeling van 3,4 km door Xhoffraix.

name: Petite Fagne de Xhoffraix (MDY02)
parkingAddress: Ruelle Adam 1-9, 4960 Xhoffraix (Chez Remy tavern parking)
notes: Family walk combining fens, Pouhon valley, and village. Blue rectangle with peacock logo.
routeSource: Malmedy Tourism / East Belgium official route
summary: Gemakkelijke wandeling van 5,5 km door venen en Pouhon-vallei.

name: Cascade du Bayehon (MDY01)
parkingAddress: Route du Bayehon 64, 4960 Longfaye (Moulin du Bayehon parking)
notes: Valleys, Bayehon waterfall (largest natural waterfall in Belgium), and fens. Moderate elevation.
summary: Wandeling van 12,6 km naar de hoogste natuurlijke waterval van België.

name: Panorama et crêtes: Xhoffraix
notes: Walk above the Warche valley loops, between steep rocks and torrents. Green diamond marking. Long ridge progression.
routeSource: East Belgium Tourism / Cirkwi official route
summary: Wandeling van 14 km over bergkammen boven de Warche-vallei.

name: Signal de Botrange: Through the Fens
parkingAddress: Rue de Botrange 131, 4950 Waimes (Signal de Botrange parking)
notes: Heart of the High Fens, Belgium's highest point area. Red rectangle marking. Boardwalks through moor.
summary: Wandeling van 6,4 km door het hart van de Hoge Venen op houten vlonders.

name: Reinhardstein Castle & Warche Valley
parkingAddress: Rue de Barrage, 4950 Robertville (Robertville dam parking)
notes: Panoramic views of Reinhardstein Castle, Napoleon's Nose rock formation, Warche valley. Green rectangle marking.
summary: Wandeling van 6 km met panorama op kasteel Reinhardstein en Warche-vallei.

name: Carrefour Malmedy
notes: Hypermarket with bakery, butcher, fish market, fruits and vegetables.
summary: Hypermarkt met bakkerij, slagerij, viswinkel en groente en fruit.

name: Delhaize Malmedy
notes: Open daily including Sundays and holidays. Fresh products, bakery, butcher, local products.
summary: Supermarkt open elke dag inclusief zondagochtend met verse producten.

name: Colruyt Malmedy
notes: Full-service grocery store.
summary: Volledige supermarkt met ruim assortiment.

name: ALDI Malmedy
notes: Discount supermarket with essentials and daily arrivals.
summary: Discountsupermarkt met dagelijks verse producten.

name: Lidl Malmedy
address: Avenue du Pont de Warche 5A, 4960 Malmedy, Belgium
notes: Discount grocery store.
summary: Discount supermarkt, gesloten op zondag.

name: Proxy Delhaize Waimes
notes: Neighborhood supermarket open daily including Sunday morning. Fresh products, bakery, local items.
summary: Buurt supermarkt open elke dag inclusief zondagochtend.

name: BioShop Malmedy
notes: Organic market with vegetarian/vegan foods, fresh produce, dairy alternatives, local products.
summary: Biologische winkel met vegetarische en veganistische producten en lokale groenten.

name: Carrefour Market Stavelot
notes: Market format supermarket.
summary: Supermarkt in Stavelot, open op zondag.

name: Okay Stavelot
notes: Neighborhood supermarket open daily including Sunday morning.
summary: Buurtsupermarkt open elke dag inclusief zondagochtend.
